provenance.method: Read-only GitHub connector responses parsed as JSON and serialized with two-space indentation and a trailing newline. Complete collected workflow, job, check, status, artifact, PR and Git commit API records are retained below.
provenance.pagination: Every listed collection was requested with per_page=100, page=1. Loaded array lengths equal each API total_count; no additional collection pages were required. Jobs and check-runs used filter=all.
provenance.artifact_digest_scope: Digests are GitHub REST artifact metadata and claims in the preserved GitHub Actions job logs. This audit did not download, extract or independently rehash the ZIP archive bytes.
provenance.source_identity: Published head and synthetic test-merge have the same Git tree. Job logs record execution from the synthetic test-merge.
provenance.snapshot_limit: Counts describe the recorded snapshot. Later PR body edits can add submission-format workflow/check runs.

pull_request.title: Separate and verify compiler stage boundaries
pull_request.body:
## Problem

Compiler discovery still rendered C adapters, and module/export admission happened during lowering. Full verification also exposed persistent JIT discovery failures with symlinked LLVM tools.

## Change

Complete six guarded, attempt-owned stages; retain validated C ABI plans until serialization and finish admission before exposing finalized IR. Add finalized-only inspection, bound reports and a Lean pipeline model. Resolve LLVM paths and invalidate stale negative caches. Merge alpha.3 constructor/representation work, capture its dynamic layouts at finalization, and test actual hierarchy retries. Typing, representation and specialization remain coupled. ChatGPT-assisted implementation and independent agent reviews. Refs #767, #709, #409.

## Validation

Head d266e919 integrates main 6bf3f73; fresh CI is pending. Static merge checks preserve every other main file. Local execution is unavailable, so full-profile, parity and cost requalification remain incomplete. Earlier 5ccd1841 passed bootstrap, 4,579 corpus comparisons, 409 Lean tests and 535 bounded obligations/uses; those results predate alpha.3. The fresh full local run lost execution access during bootstrap and has no confirmed outcome. [Integration status and prior evidence](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/blob/292dbae3d9ba47d9275e0598d3264aab979189ee/research/compiler-stage-completion-2026-11-15/STATUS_ALPHA3.md). Draft and unmerged.
